images.tooltip: Clip frames (an IMAGE batch, one frame per batch item).

hint_quality.tooltip: How much the model should trust the hint.

invert_hint.tooltip: Turn on for the mask of a cutout PNG from Load Image (its MASK is 1 - alpha). Masks painted in the Mask Editor are already white = subject; leave this off.

despill.tooltip: Green/blue spill removal on the foreground. Changing it re-runs the key; use the Despill node for instant tweaking.

alpha_hint.tooltip: Optional subject hint, white = subject. One mask is used on the first frame and carried through the clip; a mask per frame is used on every frame.

output_tooltips: Foreground with the matte as a 4th channel.
CorridorKey2Basic.name: CorridorKey2Basic
CorridorKey2Basic.description: Pulls a matte and a clean foreground from green/blue-screen footage. Feed it the clip as an IMAGE batch; optionally give a hint mask for the subject. Memory use, the temporal window and hint carry-over are chosen automatically.
